<style>
.quarto-title-banner {
  background-image: url("www/images/DJI_0014.jpeg");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  
  /* Make it taller */
  min-height: 150px;
  
  color: white; 
}

.quarto-title-banner .title, 
.quarto-title-banner .subtitle, 
.quarto-title-banner .author {
  text-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); /* make text readable */
}

</style>

<style>
#loading-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: #ffffffcc;
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
}

#loading-overlay.hidden {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Spinner */
.spinner {
  border: 8px solid #c3c3c3; 
  border-top: 8px solid #054163; 
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

@keyframes spin {
  0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

#loading-overlay p {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #054163;
}
</style>

<div id="loading-overlay">
  <div class="spinner"></div>
  <p>Loading the latest SARGE data…</p>
</div>

<script>
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("hideLoadingOverlay", function(message) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById("loading-overlay");
  overlay.classList.add("hidden");       // triggers fade-out
  setTimeout(() => overlay.remove(), 600); // remove from DOM after fade
});
</script>

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| context: setup

# Load packages
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(plotly)

## Load data ##
# Note this code could be adapted for use with the RAD8 (Durridge) and LI7820 N2O Analyzer

## Specifications ##

TIMEZONE <- "EST" # Used across all

# Specify variable choices

exo_choices <- c(
  "DO_mgL", "FDOM_RFU", "Chlorophyll_ugL", "Conductivity",
  "DO_saturation", "Salinity_PPT", "TDS_mgL", "pH", "Temp_C",
  "Depth_m"
)

hydrology_choices <- c(
  "Water_depth_m", "Flowrate_ms", "Index_velocity_ms",
  "Mean_velocity_ms"
)

ghg_choices <- c(
  "H2O_ppm", "CO2d_ppm", "CH4d_ppb", "Cavity_pressure",
  "Cavity_temperature"
)

radon_choices <- c("Relative_humidity_pct", "Radon_Bqm3", "Radon_error_Bqm3")

# Specify colors

exo_colors <- c(
  "Depth_m" = "darkblue",
  "DO_mgL" = "lightblue",
  "pH" = "pink",
  "Salinity_PPT" = "grey50",
  "Temp_C" = "red",
  "FDOM_RFU" = "brown",
  "Chlorophyll_ugL" = "darkgreen",
  "Conductivity" = "grey20",
  "DO_saturation" = "lightblue",
  "TDS_mgL" = "orange"
)

hydrology_colors <- c(
  "Water_depth_m" = "darkblue",
  "Flowrate_ms" = "lightblue1",
  "Index_velocity_ms" = "lightblue3",
  "Mean_velocity_ms" = "lightblue4"
)

ghg_colors <- c(
  "H2O_ppm" = "lightblue",
  "CO2d_ppm" = "goldenrod",
  "CH4d_ppb" = "red4",
  "Cavity_pressure" = "purple4",
  "Cavity_temperature" = "red"
)

rad_colors <- c(
  "Relative_humidity_pct" = "lightblue",
  "Radon_Bqm3" = "purple",
  "Radon_error_Bqm3" = "darkblue"
)
```

```{r}
#| panel: input
#| layout-ncol: 2

dateInput(
  "start_date",
  "Start date for plots",
  value = Sys.Date()
)

dateInput(
  "end_date",
  "End date for plots",
  value = Sys.Date()
)
```

```{r}
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

Sys.setenv(TZ = TIMEZONE)

output$data_ready <- renderText({
  ready <- nrow(exo) > 0 &&
    nrow(hydrology) > 0 &&
    #nrow(ghg) > 0 &&
    nrow(radon) > 0

  if (ready) "true" else "false"
})

outputOptions(output, "data_ready", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

## LOAD DATA ##

exo <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wilsonsj100/serc-lateral-flux/refs/heads/dashboard/Processed_data/GCREW_MARSH_OUTLET_EXO.csv")%>%
  mutate(TIMESTAMP = paste(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
         TIMESTAMP = ymd_hms(TIMESTAMP, tz = TIMEZONE))

hydrology <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wilsonsj100/serc-lateral-flux/refs/heads/dashboard/Processed_data/GCREW_MARSH_OUTLET_HYDROLOGY.csv")%>%
  mutate(TIMESTAMP = paste(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
         TIMESTAMP = ymd_hms(TIMESTAMP, tz = TIMEZONE))

radon <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wilsonsj100/serc-lateral-flux/refs/heads/dashboard/Processed_data/GCREW_MARSH_OUTLET_RADON.csv")%>%
  mutate(TIMESTAMP = paste(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
         TIMESTAMP = ymd_hms(TIMESTAMP, tz = TIMEZONE))

# TO DO: Still need GHG

# Set min and max for date input
min_date <- min(
  c(
    exo$TIMESTAMP,
    hydrology$TIMESTAMP,
    #ghg$TIMESTAMP,
    radon$TIMESTAMP
  ),
  na.rm = T
)

max_date <- max(
  c(
    exo$TIMESTAMP,
    hydrology$TIMESTAMP,
    #ghg$TIMESTAMP,
    radon$TIMESTAMP
  ),
  na.rm = T
)

updateDateInput(
  inputId = "start_date",
  min = min_date,
  max = Sys.Date(),
  value = max_date - days(7)
)

updateDateInput(
  inputId = "end_date",
  min = min_date,
  max = Sys.Date(),
  value = max_date
)

# Code for plots
output$plot_exo_dock <- renderPlotly({
  exo_recent <- exo %>%
    filter(
      Site == "DOCK",
      as.Date(TIMESTAMP) >= input$start_date,
      as.Date(TIMESTAMP) <= input$end_date
    ) %>%
    select(TIMESTAMP, all_of(input$exo_vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(input$exo_vars)

  p1 <- exo_recent %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = value, color = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    theme_classic() +
    facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = exo_colors) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )+
    ggtitle("DOCK")

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("TIMESTAMP", "value"))
})

output$plot_exo_flume <- renderPlotly({
  exo_recent <- exo %>%
    filter(
      Site == "FLUME",
      as.Date(TIMESTAMP) >= input$start_date,
      as.Date(TIMESTAMP) <= input$end_date
    ) %>%
    select(TIMESTAMP, all_of(input$exo_vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(input$exo_vars)

  p1 <- exo_recent %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = value, color = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    theme_classic() +
    facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = exo_colors) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )+
    ggtitle("FLUME")

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("TIMESTAMP", "value"))
})

# todays date for overview page
now_txt <- reactiveTimer(1000) # Gets the current time every second

# Max timesteps for overview page
output$data_latest <- renderText({
  #formatted_date_ghg <- paste(
  #  format(
  #    max(ghg$TIMESTAMP, na.rm = T),
  #    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
  #  ),
  #  TIMEZONE
  #)
  #ghg_color <- if (now() - max(ghg$TIMESTAMP, na.rm = T) > hours(1)) {
  #  ' style="color: #990000;"'
  #} else {
  #  ""
  #}
  
  exo_times <- exo %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarize(max = max(TIMESTAMP[!if_any(-TIMESTAMP, is.na)], na.rm = T),
              formatted = ifelse(is.finite(max),
                                 paste(
                                   format(max, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                                   TIMEZONE
                                 ),
                                 "No data"),
              color = ifelse(formatted == "No data" || 
                               (now() - max) > hours(1),
                             ' style="color: #990000;"',
                             ""))
  
  radon_times <- radon %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarize(max = max(TIMESTAMP[!if_any(-TIMESTAMP, is.na)], na.rm = T),
              formatted = ifelse(is.finite(max),
                                 paste(
                                   format(max, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                                   TIMEZONE
                                 ),
                                 "No data"),
              color = ifelse(formatted == "No data" || 
                               (now() - max) > hours(1),
                             ' style="color: #990000;"',
                             ""))
  
  hydrology_times <- hydrology %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarize(max = max(TIMESTAMP[!if_any(-TIMESTAMP, is.na)], na.rm = T),
              formatted = ifelse(is.finite(max),
                                 paste(
                                   format(max, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                                   TIMEZONE
                                 ),
                                 "No data"),
              color = ifelse(formatted == "No data" || 
                               (now() - max) > hours(1),
                             ' style="color: #990000;"',
                             ""))
  
  formatted_list <- paste(
    "DOCK:</br>
    <ul><li", exo_times$color[exo_times$Site == "DOCK"], 
    "><b>EXO2 water quality sonde:</b> ", exo_times$formatted[exo_times$Site == "DOCK"], "</li>
    <li", hydrology_times$color[hydrology_times$Site == "DOCK"], 
    "><b>SontekIQ ADCP:</b> ", hydrology_times$formatted[hydrology_times$Site == "DOCK"], "</li>
    <li", radon_times$color[radon_times$Site == "DOCK"], 
    "><b>Radon detector:</b> ", radon_times$formatted[radon_times$Site == "DOCK"], "</li></ul></br>
    FLUME:</br>
    <ul><li", exo_times$color[exo_times$Site == "FLUME"], 
    "><b>EXO2 water quality sonde:</b> ", exo_times$formatted[exo_times$Site == "FLUME"], "</li>
    <li", hydrology_times$color[hydrology_times$Site == "FLUME"], 
    "><b>SontekIQ ADCP:</b> ", hydrology_times$formatted[hydrology_times$Site == "FLUME"], "</li>
    <li", radon_times$color[radon_times$Site == "FLUME"], 
    "><b>Radon detector:</b> ", radon_times$formatted[radon_times$Site == "FLUME"], "</li></ul>"
  ) #    <li", ghg_color, "><b>GHG analyzer:</b> ", formatted_date_ghg, "</li>
  
  return(formatted_list)
})

# Render the current time as a text output
output$today <- renderText({
  paste("Current time: ", format(now_txt(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), TIMEZONE)
})

# Add an observer at the end of your server setup
observe({
  # Wait until all data is loaded
  req(nrow(exo) > 0, nrow(hydrology) > 0, nrow(radon) > 0) #nrow(ghg) > 0, 

  # Hide the overlay using JavaScript
  session$sendCustomMessage("hideLoadingOverlay", TRUE)
})
```
